data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a significant gross reserve release of GBP 37.982 million due to an External Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transfer for the 2012-2014 run-off years. This transfer moved the liabilities of the specialist sports and leisure book to another syndicate. Concurrently, there was an unquantified gross strengthening of reserves for the Professional Indemnity book, specifically for the 2016 underwriting year of account, following a review of cladding exposures and other potential claims. The overall cost of 2017 catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and Mexico earthquakes) remained within expectations during 2018, implying no further adverse development for these events.
